text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (I still hate when things are a pain.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It's absolutely freezing out here. Wait, you can still see the stars. Ugh, I should've worn more layers.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But going all the way back would be a pain too…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh well.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (You know, even after all we've been through, I still think you're wasting your time.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (You're so smart. You come up with really amazing strategies.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (Someone smart who could actually understand them would pair with you so much better than a dummy like me.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (But…)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, close one.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'll just tape this right up. Let's see…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: There… Hehe. My nails are looking as good as ever. All right, one more set.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: And… done.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh wow. Was that a new record? I'm killing it today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Beep, beep, beep!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh shoot! School's gonna start soon!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I gotta shower, do my makeup—oh, I can try out my new mascara!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: All right, time to go.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …Bakushin. Bakushin.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (I'm a dummy, so all I can do is what I'm told.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (And I guess I've done what I'm told so much that my legs just know what to do now.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (So maybe… Maybe there's really a chance…)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …I can become the amazing Umamusume you say I can be.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer, check it. New nail tips. Cute, right?
choice_data_list: Your nails are looking healthy too.
Your nails are looking healthy too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yep, they're so tough now, I can put on as much tape as I want.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, is that all you've got to say? C'mon.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: There we go! Just looking at them makes you happy, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Anyways, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Hey, is your trainee really running in the autumn Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Hold on. If that's true, she needs to take her training more seriously. The competition for this year's fall Tenno is no joke.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: It's an all-star field. Not to mention the Derby winner, Eishin Flash, will be there too.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: You've also got big talent making a comeback… It's shaping up to be a race to remember.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Plus, her peers are making a lot of progress too. Did you hear about Nakayama Festa? You guys really need to get your act tog—

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: You say that, but you need to fix your eyes on the actual race.
choice_data_list: On the day of, she's going to run to win.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Have you always been so dumb when it comes to your trainee?
choice_data_list: Yeah, we're just a regular couple of dummies.
Yeah, we're just a regular couple of dummies.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I'm sooo freakin' thirsty!
choice_data_list: Okay, break time! Come get a drink!
Okay, break time! Come get a drink!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh?! C'mon! Can't you bring it to me?

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Pffft, hahaha. Is that right? I guess you two make a good pair, then.

text_block_list.name: Gyaru A
text_block_list.text: Jordan, are you really running in the fall Tenno?! That's so sick!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru B
text_block_list.text: There's gonna be, like, a ton of crazy strong runners, right? And you're—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win?

text_block_list.name: Gyarus
text_block_list.text: Yasss, queen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: How you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, Palmer! Pretty good, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You're on fire! ☆ Don't think I don't see you training hard!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Of course I am. The fall Tenno is right around the corner. Also…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You guys should totally come watch. I'm gonna run faster than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It's gonna be like nothing you've ever seen.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You're setting the bar pretty high.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It's fiiine. After all…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I don't want you to miss seeing me become the greatest!

text_block_list.name: Moderator
text_block_list.text: Let's move on to the Q&A portion of our joint press conference with the runners of the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I have a question for Tosen Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Recently, Nakayama Festa had a fantastic second-place showing in France! As her classmate, wh—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Amazing, right? Nakayama's really killing it too. I was so surprised.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But my race is here. This is where I'm going to become the greatest.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: When you say you'll become the greatest… you're talking about winning the fall Tenno?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah… no. Actually, what I mean is like…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna be the greatest Uma like… ever? Of all time?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Ever?! Are you saying you're aiming for a new record?! But… looking at your stats… Well…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …So you're saying it's pointless for me to even try?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Well… I just…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You can laugh. I think it sounds pretty dumb myself.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But for what it's worth… there are people who really believe in me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That's why I've gotta do it. No matter how dumb anyone thinks it is.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haha… So print that in bold in your magazine or your newspaper or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna make it big… as the greatest dummy ever!
